side.title: Small Tank
side.hint: The scooter's tank holds just enough for the shortest run. Waste nothing.
side.log: Logbook, day 1. The depot never says who the packages are from. Only where they go.

side.title: Before It Melts
side.hint: Every delivery before the clock runs out, or it's all soup.
side.log: Day 9. A kid asked where the van sleeps at night. I said the depot. I've never actually seen it park there.

side.title: No Brakes
side.hint: Plan the whole run, then light it. The rocket doesn't stop till it's done.
side.log: Day 23. Every route on the map stops one street short of the edge. Somebody planned it that way.

side.title: Fog Bank
side.hint: Memorise the load: the fog rolls in and hides all but the next package.
side.log: Day 31. In the fog the radio crackled: the Dispatcher, reading out my next stop. In my own voice.

side.title: Twin Towns
side.hint: Two towns, one van. Deliver everything, then take the exit to the next town.
side.log: Day 40. Two towns with the same street names. In the other one, someone in a van just like mine waved back.

side.title: The Big Map
side.hint: Four parts, one big map, saved as you go. Finish them all to win.
side.log: Day 50. The last mile isn't the end of the road. It's where the one underneath begins.
